popCulture.title: Cretheus
popCulture.description: Aeolid founder-king of Iolcus, husband of Tyro, father of Aeson, Pheres and Amythaon — the grandfather-line of Jason and the Argonauts.

popCulture.title: Aeson
popCulture.description: Cretheus' son — rightful king of Iolcus and father of Jason; Medea's rejuvenation scenes keep the Cretheid house on canvas even when Cretheus himself is offstage.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: Cretheus' grandson — the Argonaut captain whose claim on Iolcus runs through Aeson's line from the city's founder.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: The epic of the Argo inherits Cretheus as the Iolcan stem — the Aeolid king whose house Pelias usurped and Jason sailed to restore.
